mapper.select: SELECT c.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS nameKo, s.BIRTHS AS births, s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, s.INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality, s.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita, s.URBAN_RATE AS urbanRate, s.SEX_RATIO_BIRTH AS sexRatioBirth FROM COUNTRY c JOIN COUNTRY_STAT s ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = s.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND s.DECADE = #{decade} AND s.BIRTHS > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ABANDONED', ENDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GUEST_TOKEN = #{guestToken} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE ( LIFE_ID, MEMBER_ID, GUEST_TOKEN, START_TYPE, NAME, GENDER, BIRTH_COUNTRY, CURRENT_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, WEALTH_CLASS, IS_URBAN, HEALTH, HAPPINESS, KNOWLEDGE, RELATION ) VALUES ( #{lifeId}, #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{guestToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startType}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthCountry}, #{currentCountry}, #{birthYear}, #{wealthClass}, #{isUrban}, #{health}, #{happiness}, #{knowledge}, #{relation} )
